title: Integral optimum bounded by the SDP optimum
statement: Let $G$ be a weighted directed graph on a finite vertex set of size $n$, with nonnegative symmetric weights, total ordered-pair weight $1$, and zero diagonal weights. Then the supremum of the cut values over all Boolean labelings is at most the supremum of the SDP values over all assignments of unit vectors in $\mathbb R^n$.
hypotheses_covered: Weights are nonnegative for every ordered pair.
The sum of all ordered-pair weights is $1$.
